name: YS LeadGen – Popup Builder, Contact Form Builder, Exit Intent, Optin Forms & Lead Generation
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
Turn Leaving Website Visitors Into Email Subscribers, Qualified Leads, and Paying Customers.

Most visitors come to your website, browse for a minute, and leave without buying anything, joining your newsletter, or filling out a contact form.

Normally, fixing that requires installing four or five separate plugins—or paying monthly SaaS fees—just to get exit intent popups, contact and payment forms, spin-to-win coupon wheels, floating announcement bars, and WooCommerce cart abandonment recovery.

YS LeadGen gives you a complete popup builder, contact and payment form builder, gamified spin wheel creator, and WooCommerce conversion suite inside one fast, native WordPress plugin.

Using a visual drag and drop editor right inside your WordPress dashboard, you can launch high-converting exit intent popups, sticky floating bars, gamified coupon wheels, interactive quizzes, multi-step forms, conversational forms, and WooCommerce upsell popups in minutes. You never need to write code, you never pay recurring monthly SaaS bills based on pageviews, and every lead you collect stays 100% in your own WordPress database.

Try the Live Demo | Official Website | Documentation | Pricing & Plans

Why WordPress Site Owners & Agencies Choose YS LeadGen

  • One Visual Builder for Popups & Forms: Design lightbox popups, sticky bars, slide-ins, and embedded page forms on the same live drag and drop canvas with smooth submission transitions.
  • Proven Template Library: Launch faster with ready-made templates for newsletter optins, flash sales, spin-to-win wheels, cart recovery, quizzes, and lead capture forms.
  • Desktop & Mobile Exit Intent Technology: Catch visitors the exact moment they are about to leave—tracking upward mouse movement on desktop and fast scroll-up gestures or back-button taps on mobile phones.
  • Built-In WooCommerce Cart Recovery & Upsells: Stop cart abandonment on cart and checkout pages, auto-generate unique discount coupons on signup, and display targeted product upsell or cross-sell popups.
  • Complete Form Builder With Conditional Logic & Payments: Build contact forms, multi-step forms, conversational forms, file upload forms, surveys, and payment forms powered by Stripe, PayPal, and Square.
  • Precision Targeting & Paragraph Insertion Rules: Trigger campaigns by page, category, in-post paragraph number, scroll depth, time delay, device, visitor country or state, traffic source, UTM parameter, or WooCommerce cart conditions.
  • A/B Split Testing, Revenue Analytics, GA4 & AI Insights: Test campaign variations side by side, track views, conversions, and WooCommerce revenue, sync events to Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and get built-in AI optimization tips.
  • 100% Data Ownership & Direct CRM Integrations: Save every lead in your WordPress database, export to CSV anytime, or auto-sync with Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Brevo, HubSpot, Omnisend, ActiveCampaign, GetResponse, Drip, Kit, Zapier, and Make.
  • Lightweight, Fast Frontend Performance: Scripts load conditionally only on pages where an active campaign is running, keeping your Core Web Vitals and page speed fast.

17+ High-Converting Popup & Form Campaign Types

Instead of managing multiple plugins with conflicting scripts, build all of your lead generation and conversion campaigns in one place:

1. Popups, Sticky Floating Bars & Slide-Ins

  • Lightbox Popups: Classic centered popups over a dimmed backdrop that put full focus on your email optin, lead magnet, or special discount.
  • Exit Intent Popups: Trigger a last-chance offer or cart saver the exact millisecond a visitor moves to close your tab or leave checkout.
  • Sticky Floating Bars: Keep a high-visibility header or footer bar on screen for storewide sales, free shipping thresholds, or announcements.
  • Slide-In Scroll Boxes: Politely slide an optin box or related offer into the corner of the screen once a reader scrolls down a blog post.
  • Fullscreen Welcome Mats: Greet arriving traffic with a distraction-free, full-screen promotion before they scroll into the page content.
  • Floating Action Badges: Add a persistent launcher icon in the corner of your site that opens a popup, contact form, or feedback widget on click.

2. Gamified, Interactive & Compliance Popups

  • Spin-to-Win Coupon Wheels: Turn email signups into a game by letting visitors spin a prize wheel to win an instant WooCommerce discount code.
  • Yes/No Two-Step Optin Popups: Use the psychological Zeigarnik effect by asking a simple Yes/No question before revealing the email signup field.
  • Interactive Quiz Popups: Guide visitors through a series of questions to segment leads and recommend the right product or service.
  • Countdown Timer Popups: Drive immediate action on flash sales and seasonal promotions with a live countdown clock.
  • Content Lockers: Require visitors to enter their email address to unlock premium article sections, guides, or downloadable resources.
  • Social Proof Notifications: Display subtle corner alerts highlighting recent signups or store activity to build instant visitor trust.
  • Video Lightbox Popups: Open YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted product and explainer videos inside a clean, responsive modal player.
  • Age Verification & GDPR Cookie Consent Popups: Restrict age-sensitive content behind an age gate, or display a cookie consent banner that blocks tracking scripts until accepted.

3. Embedded, Conversational & Payment Forms

  • Inline & Auto-Inserted Post Forms: Embed optin or lead forms anywhere via shortcode/blocks, or automatically inject them after specific paragraphs inside blog posts.
  • Multi-Step & Conversational Forms: Break complex forms into bite-sized steps, or use a modern, Typeform-style conversational layout that asks one question at a time.
  • Contact, Conditional Logic & File Upload Forms: Create dynamic contact forms, client intake forms, and NPS surveys with smart conditional fields and file uploads.
  • Stripe, PayPal & Square Payment Forms: Collect one-time payments, service deposits, donations, or product orders directly inside your forms with built-in sandbox test mode.

How to Launch a Campaign in 5 Simple Steps

  1. Pick a Template or Start Blank: Choose a conversion-tested design from the template library or start from a clean canvas.
  2. Customize in the Drag & Drop Editor: Edit headlines, colors, fonts, animations, and custom form fields with live visual feedback.
  3. Set Your Smart Triggers: Choose when the campaign appears—such as exit intent, time delay, scroll percentage, or clicking a button/link.
  4. Apply Visitor & Page Targeting: Select which pages, devices, countries/states, traffic sources, or WooCommerce cart conditions should display the campaign.
  5. Publish & Track Conversions: Set your campaign live in one click and monitor views, leads, and revenue in real time.

Precision Triggers & Visitor Targeting Rules

High-performing popups succeed because they show the right message to the right person at the right time. YS LeadGen lets you layer multiple conditions using flexible AND/OR logic:

  • Behavioral Triggers: Desktop and mobile exit intent, time on page, scroll depth percentage, element click trigger, on-site retargeting, or scheduled start/end dates.
  • Page, Post & Paragraph Rules: Show or hide campaigns on specific pages, posts, categories, custom URLs, or automatically after a chosen paragraph inside articles.
  • Device, Browser & OS Targeting: Tailor separate campaigns for desktop, tablet, and mobile visitors, or target by browser, operating system, and browser language.
  • Geo-Location Targeting (Country & State): Display localized offers, shipping notices, or regional compliance banners based on the visitor’s country or state.
  • Traffic Source & UTM Parameter Rules: Personalize campaigns based on referral URLs or specific UTM/URL query parameters from your ad campaigns.
  • New vs. Returning Visitor Frequency: Control how often a visitor sees a popup, welcome first-time visitors, or automatically hide campaigns from subscribers who already converted.

Built for WooCommerce: Recover Abandoned Carts & Boost Order Value

If you run a WooCommerce store, YS LeadGen gives you specialized e-commerce triggers and rules to maximize revenue from your existing traffic:

  • Cart & Checkout Abandonment Popups: Detect when a shopper is about to abandon their cart or checkout page and present an instant discount or helpful reminder.
  • Automated Cart Recovery Emails: Follow up automatically when a shopper leaves items behind to bring them back to complete their checkout.
  • Dynamic WooCommerce Coupon Generation: Automatically generate and display a unique WooCommerce coupon code the moment a shopper subscribes.
  • Product Upsell & Cross-Sell Popups: Recommend complementary products or higher-tier bundles in a popup when specific items are added to the cart.
  • Advanced Cart & Coupon Page Rules: Trigger campaigns based on total cart value, item count, specific products in the cart, or whether the shopper is on the cart, checkout, or coupon page.

Optimize ROI With Revenue Analytics, A/B Testing & AI Insights

  • Popup, Form & WooCommerce Revenue Analytics: Track impressions, submissions, conversion rates, and exact WooCommerce revenue attributed to each campaign.
  • A/B Split Testing: Test different headlines, offers, layouts, or triggers head-to-head to discover your highest-converting winner.
  • Built-In AI Insights: Let the AI assistant analyze your campaign metrics and highlight actionable opportunities to improve conversion rates.
  • Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Integration: Automatically push popup and form view/conversion events to your GA4 property for unified marketing attribution.
  • Centralized Lead Hub & JSON Portability: Search, filter, and export all collected leads to CSV, or export/import full campaign setups as portable JSON files.
  • Works With Every Page Builder & Form Plugin: Fully compatible with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Bricks, Beaver Builder, and Oxygen. You can also wrap and track existing Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, or Fluent Forms inside YS LeadGen popups.
  • Built-In SMTP & Google reCAPTCHA: Configure custom SMTP delivery right inside the plugin so form notifications always hit the inbox, and block bots with Google reCAPTCHA.

Want to test the visual builder before installing? Try the live interactive demo, explore our step-by-step documentation, or compare plans on the pricing page.

External Services

YS LeadGen does not contact any outside service until you turn on a feature or integration that needs one:

  • Email marketing services: Used only if you connect one in Integrations. When a visitor submits a campaign linked to a connected service, their submitted details (such as name and email address) are sent to that service: Mailchimp, Brevo, Klaviyo, GetResponse, Drip, ActiveCampaign, Kit, Omnisend, and HubSpot. Each service’s own terms and privacy policy apply.
  • Stripe, PayPal, and Square: Used only if you add a payment field to a form. The payment amount and details needed to process the transaction are sent to the provider when a visitor submits the form. Stripe | PayPal | Square
  • Webhooks (Zapier, Make, or another URL): Used only if you add a webhook to a campaign. Lead data is sent to the URL you provide each time the campaign captures a lead. Zapier | Make
  • Google Analytics 4: Used only if you enable GA4 tracking. Campaign events, such as views and conversions, are sent to your Google Analytics property. Privacy policy
  • Google reCAPTCHA: Used only on forms where you turn reCAPTCHA on. When such a form loads or is submitted, the visitor’s IP address and browser interaction data are sent to Google. Terms | Privacy policy
  • YouTube and Vimeo: Used only if you add a video popup embedding a video from one of these services. The visitor’s browser loads the player directly from the provider, which may receive the visitor’s IP address. YouTube | Vimeo

Privacy

YS LeadGen runs on your own WordPress site and does not collect personal information on its own, only through the forms and popups you build. If you connect a third-party service, such as an email marketing tool, the information a visitor submits is sent to that service once the connection is turned on. You stay responsible for your site’s privacy policy and for meeting the privacy laws that apply to you.
sections.installation:
Minimum System Requirements

  • WordPress 5.3 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard and go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for YS LeadGen.
  3. Click Install Now, and then click Activate.
  4. Open YS LeadGen from your left-hand WordPress admin menu.
  5. Click Add New Campaign, choose a popup or form template, set your trigger and targeting rules, and click Publish.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the YS LeadGen plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the ZIP file, click Install Now, and activate the plugin.

Quick Setup Tips

  • Connect Your CRM: Go to YS LeadGen > Integrations to link Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Brevo, HubSpot, Omnisend, ActiveCampaign, or Webhooks.
  • Enable WooCommerce Rules: Go to YS LeadGen > Ecommerce Rules to configure cart abandonment popups, checkout triggers, and upsells.
  • Need Help? Browse our full setup guides in the YS LeadGen documentation.
sections.faq:
How is YS LeadGen different from SaaS popup tools like OptinMonster or Typeform?

YS LeadGen is a 100% native WordPress plugin rather than an external cloud SaaS subscription. You do not have to pay monthly fees based on pageviews or impression limits, you get both a visual popup builder and a full form builder in one plugin, and all of your leads and analytics stay privately inside your own WordPress database.

Do I need coding skills to build popups or forms?

No. Every popup, floating bar, spin wheel, and form is built using a live drag and drop visual editor. You can start from a ready-made template, customize colors, text, and fields, and publish in minutes without touching a single line of code.

Can I build embedded page forms, conversational forms, and payment forms?

Yes. YS LeadGen includes a complete form builder for contact forms, multi-step forms, Typeform-style conversational forms (one question at a time), conditional logic forms, file upload forms, surveys, and payment forms powered by Stripe, PayPal, and Square. You can display any form inside a popup or embed it directly inside your pages and blog posts.

How does exit intent work on both desktop and mobile devices?

On desktop computers, exit intent tracks mouse velocity and direction as the visitor’s cursor moves toward the browser tab bar or close button. On mobile phones, where there is no mouse cursor, YS LeadGen detects rapid upward scroll gestures or back-button taps to display your offer before the visitor leaves.

Does YS LeadGen work with WooCommerce for cart abandonment and upsells?

Yes. You can trigger exit intent or time-delayed popups on the WooCommerce cart and checkout pages, send automated cart recovery emails, generate dynamic WooCommerce discount coupons upon signup, and target shoppers by cart total, items in cart, or coupon page visits.

Where is my lead and form submission data stored?

Every lead and form entry is stored directly in your own WordPress database. Your visitor data is never shared with any third party unless you explicitly enable an email marketing integration or webhook. You can view, search, filter, and export your leads to a CSV file anytime.

Is YS LeadGen GDPR compliant?

Yes. Because YS LeadGen stores leads locally in your WordPress database by default, you maintain full control over visitor data. The plugin also includes GDPR consent checkboxes for forms and a built-in Cookie Consent banner that can block tracking scripts until the visitor opts in.

Will YS LeadGen slow down my website or affect Core Web Vitals?

No. YS LeadGen is engineered for speed and loads its frontend scripts only on pages where an active campaign is targeted to run. Pages without an active popup or form load zero extra assets.

Which page builders and third-party form plugins are supported?

YS LeadGen works seamlessly with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg (Block Editor), Bricks, Beaver Builder, and Oxygen. If you already have forms built in Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, or Fluent Forms, you can display and track them inside YS LeadGen popups too.

Which CRM, email marketing, and analytics tools can I connect?

You can sync leads directly with Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Brevo, HubSpot, Omnisend, ActiveCampaign, GetResponse, Drip, and Kit (ConvertKit), or send lead data to Zapier, Make, or any custom endpoint via Webhooks. You can also send campaign view and conversion events directly to Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

Does YS LeadGen include A/B testing and AI optimization?

Yes. You can run A/B split tests to compare two versions of a popup or form, and use built-in AI Insights to automatically evaluate campaign performance and see which campaigns need adjustments.

Can I try a live demo before installing?

Yes. You can test the drag and drop popup and form builder right in your browser on the live demo site, read tutorials in the documentation, or compare plans on the pricing page.

  • Centralized Lead Hub & JSON Portability: Search, filter, and export all collected leads to CSV, or export/import full campaign setups as portable JSON files.
  • Works With Every Page Builder & Form Plugin: Fully compatible with Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Bricks, Beaver Builder, and Oxygen. You can also wrap and track existing Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, or Fluent Forms inside YS LeadGen popups.
  • Built-In SMTP & Google reCAPTCHA: Configure custom SMTP delivery right inside the plugin so form notifications always hit the inbox, and block bots with Google reCAPTCHA.

Want to test the visual builder before installing? Try the live interactive demo, explore our step-by-step documentation, or compare plans on the pricing page.

External Services

YS LeadGen does not contact any outside service until you turn on a feature or integration that needs one:

  • Email marketing services: Used only if you connect one in Integrations. When a visitor submits a campaign linked to a connected service, their submitted details (such as name and email address) are sent to that service: Mailchimp, Brevo, Klaviyo, GetResponse, Drip, ActiveCampaign, Kit, Omnisend, and HubSpot. Each service’s own terms and privacy policy apply.
  • Stripe, PayPal, and Square: Used only if you add a payment field to a form. The payment amount and details needed to process the transaction are sent to the provider when a visitor submits the form. Stripe | PayPal | Square
  • Webhooks (Zapier, Make, or another URL): Used only if you add a webhook to a campaign. Lead data is sent to the URL you provide each time the campaign captures a lead. Zapier | Make
  • Google Analytics 4: Used only if you enable GA4 tracking. Campaign events, such as views and conversions, are sent to your Google Analytics property. Privacy policy
  • Google reCAPTCHA: Used only on forms where you turn reCAPTCHA on. When such a form loads or is submitted, the visitor’s IP address and browser interaction data are sent to Google. Terms | Privacy policy
  • YouTube and Vimeo: Used only if you add a video popup embedding a video from one of these services. The visitor’s browser loads the player directly from the provider, which may receive the visitor’s IP address. YouTube | Vimeo

Privacy

YS LeadGen runs on your own WordPress site and does not collect personal information on its own, only through the forms and popups you build. If you connect a third-party service, such as an email marketing tool, the information a visitor submits is sent to that service once the connection is turned on. You stay responsible for your site’s privacy policy and for meeting the privacy laws that apply to you.
